premises.text: B2B companies experience high bounce rates on their websites
premises.evidence_span: convert the 99% of their traffic that bounces today

premises.text: Personalization of website content can increase leads
premises.evidence_span: the result of this personalization is a 54% increase in leads

premises.text: Different industries require tailored marketing messages
premises.evidence_span: the same marketing message didn't necessarily resonate for everybody

premises.text: Personalization requires knowledge of website visitors and their groups
premises.evidence_span: we needed to know who was coming to the website, prioritize between all of the different groups

premises.text: Most marketing teams lack the technical expertise for effective personalization
premises.evidence_span: The average marketing team does not have access to these technical expertise

premises.text: Mutiny provides a solution for website personalization in one platform
premises.evidence_span: that's exactly why we built Mutiny, to solve all of these problems in one place with software

premises.text: Mutiny uses data integration to identify website visitors
premises.evidence_span: Mutiny identifies the visitors to a website via pre-built data integration

premises.text: Mutiny analyzes traffic data to recommend audience segments for personalization
premises.evidence_span: analyzes the website's traffic and conversion data to recommend the best audiences for personalization

premises.text: Non-technical users can change website experiences using Mutiny's visual editor
premises.evidence_span: has a visual editor that lets any non-technical person change the experience of their website

premises.text: Mutiny measures the impact of personalization through built-in analytics
premises.evidence_span: it has built-in analytics to measure the results so the company can keep iterating

value.text: B2B companies can convert more traffic into leads through personalized website experiences
value.evidence_span: 200% increase in outbound leads for BRACs, 40% site-wide increase in leads for Amplitude

notes: Customer names and specific metrics are included as evidence but not coded as separate premises.
